mathematical_observations: The observed mean spacing (0.740712) is significantly larger than the predicted mean spacing (0.552) based on the Riemann-von Mangoldt formula.
The standard deviation of the observed spacings (1.020411) is much larger than the predicted standard deviation for GUE (0.422).
There are notable large gaps in the data, which are not consistent with the GUE nearest-neighbor spacing distribution.

rh_status.reasoning: The finite nature of the data and the presence of large gaps make it impossible to draw definitive conclusions about the Riemann Hypothesis from this dataset alone.

what_would_be_needed: A much larger dataset with consistent spacing patterns.
Further analysis of the distribution of spacings to identify any underlying periodicity or patterns.
Comparison with theoretical predictions from other mathematical models related to the Riemann Hypothesis.
honest_limits: The current dataset is insufficient to prove or disprove the Riemann Hypothesis.
Finite data inherently introduces limitations in statistical analysis and cannot conclusively determine the validity of complex mathematical conjectures.
